title: Assistant Education Development Officer (AEDO)
qualification: Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent from a Recognized University
salary: Selected candidates will be appointed under the salary structure specified for Assistant Education Development Officer posts in the Bihar Education Department. || Salary Clarification: Rs. 29,200 is the notified starting basic pay, not the guaranteed in-hand salary. Actual monthly salary will depend on applicable allowances, deductions and service conditions.
age_limit: The age limit is calculated as on 1 August 2026 . Candidates must be at least 21 years old.
application_fee: BPSC has prescribed an examination fee of Rs. 100 . Additional charges may apply depending on the identification and online payment method. || Payment Mode: Online through the payment methods supported by the BPSC recruitment portal. || Last Date for Fee Payment: 30 December 2026. || Examination fees once paid will not be refunded under the conditions stated in the notification.
selection_process: The Bihar Public Service Commission has prescribed a two-stage written examination for Assistant Education Development Officer recruitment. || Online application and eligibility scrutiny. || Preliminary Competitive Examination. || Shortlisting for the Main Examination. || Main Written Examination. || Preparation of the merit list based on Main Examination marks. || Original document verification. || Final recommendation for appointment. || Important: The notification does not prescribe a personal interview for the AEDO recruitment. The Preliminary Examination is used for screening, while final merit is based on the Main Examination under the prescribed rules.

title: DCPU Rohtas Vacancy 2026 - 30 Support Person PostsDCPU Rohtas Support Person Vacancy 2026
qualification: Post Graduation in Social Work (MSW)/Sociology/Psychology/Child Development or Law || OR Graduation degree in any faculty with a Diploma in Child Rights/Counselling, along with three years' experience
age_limit: Minimum 30 years and maximum 65 years, which the notice describes as the age prescribed in the State for selection of a Child Welfare Committee member. Age will be calculated as on 01.11.2026.
selection_process: Candidates will be selected on the basis of educational qualification and an interview by the Selection Committee. The DCPU will scrutinise applications and shortlist eligible candidates; if applications are very many, ten times the vacancies, category-wise, will be called for the personal interview. || The Selection Committee is chaired by the senior-most Additional District and Sessions Judge (Special Court POCSO). Its members are the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority; the District Magistrate or a nominee not below Additional District Magistrate; the Head of the Psychology/Sociology faculty of a government college or a subject expert nominated by the District Magistrate; and the Assistant Director, DCPU, as Member-Secretary. The committee will recommend a panel and a waiting list, which will be published on the district's official website and the office notice board. A criminal character verification certificate will be obtained from empanelled Support Persons after publication.

qualification: The candidate must be a citizen of India. A separate application for each post is not needed: ticking the box beside the posts shown in the registration form makes the candidate an applicant for each ticked post, and only one fee is payable. || If two candidates are in contention for one post, the desirable qualification fixed for that post decides. The post-wise desirable qualification is given in the Schedule attached to the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya (Recruitment and Service Conditions) Rules, 2018. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.
